g.data-name: Artwork / fitted bitmap, source preserved separately
UNCOMMON / antique bronze, paired rules, leaf corners
Rarity / antique bronze, paired rules, leaf corners
Portrait inlay / rank and figure emblems

text.tspan: An administration clerk keeps petitions, accounts, and
orders in a form officials can use. Exact records give
authority a memory, allowing the machinery of government to
answer practical needs beyond the palace walls.
